info.title: ERP platform API
info.description: Every action the screens perform. Sign in with POST /api/auth/sign-in (cookie, or set issueToken for a bearer token). Unsafe requests made with the cookie must send the header X-Erp-Request: 1. Each operation lists the permission it requires in x-erp-permission. Decimal values are JSON strings.

get.summary: Liveness and database connectivity.
get.x-erp-anonymous: Container health checks run without a session; returns no tenant data.

get.summary: The signed-in user's workspace and its settings.

put.summary: Rename the signed-in user's workspace (English and Arabic names) and change its settings (default language, time zone, first day of the week).

get.summary: Companies the caller may work in, a page at a time: word search on code and legal names, filters, sort, keyset or offset paging and grouping (the list query contract); by code by default.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free text. Every word must occur (anywhere, any case) in at least one of the list's search fields; Arabic words also match the letter variants people type for one another (ا أ إ آ, ي ى, ه ة, و ؤ). Without a sort, rows come best match first (when at most 10,000 rows match; the page says ranked): words at the start of a field or of a word in it, the whole search equal to or starting a field, the words in the typed order; then shorter values, then the list's default sort.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter expression, for example: language eq 'ar' and (isActive eq true or lastSignInAt is null). Operators eq ne lt le gt ge contains startswith endswith in, is null, is not null; and, or, not, parentheses. Text in single quotes (double a quote inside), numbers with a dot, dates and times as ISO 8601 text.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sortable column keys separated by commas; a leading '-' sorts descending. Defaults to best match first when there is a search, else the list's default sort.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Keyset paging: the 'next' value of the previous page. Cannot be combined with skip.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Offset paging: rows to skip. Cannot be combined with after.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 200 (default 50).

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: A groupable column key: the page also carries the groups of the filtered list with their counts and totals.

post.summary: Create a company. Only a caller who works in every company of the workspace (company codes are unique across it). The creator may work in the new company (all branches) from then on, and so may every other user who worked in every company and holds at least the creator's permissions (the workspace's other administrators keep the whole workspace).

get.summary: One company the caller may work in.

put.summary: Change a company the caller may work in, or deactivate it (isActive false). Needs every branch of the company (the record is shared by all of them); changing the code needs every company of the workspace.

get.summary: The company's logo image (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

put.summary: Replace the company's logo: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 512 KB, base64 in data. Needs every branch of the company.

delete.summary: Remove the company's logo. Needs every branch of the company.

get.summary: Branches the caller may work in (only their own branches of a company where they are limited to some), a page at a time: word search on code and names, filters (companyId eq '…' for one company), sort, keyset or offset paging and grouping (the list query contract); by code by default.

get.summary: One branch the caller may work in.

put.summary: Change a branch the caller may work in, or deactivate it (isActive false). Changing the code needs every branch of the company.

get.summary: The companies and branches (of the caller's) one user may work in.

put.summary: Set the companies and branches one user may work in. Access is a grant: only companies and branches the caller works in can be given or taken away, only from users who hold no permission the caller lacks and work in no company or branch the caller does not; callers cannot change their own access. The request carries the version read; 409 when the access changed since.

get.summary: The caller's working company and branch, and the companies and branches they may switch to.

put.summary: Switch the caller's working company and branch (kept for their next sessions).

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password (or a one-time set-up code), or with a passkey (passkey, no e-mail or password: the device's answer to the challenge from GET /api/auth/session). Sets the session cookie; returns a bearer token too when issueToken is true. With newPassword it also changes the password; a set-up code answers 409 auth.passwordChangeRequired until one is given.
post.x-erp-anonymous: Signing in is how a session starts.

post.summary: Revoke the current session and clear the cookie.
post.x-erp-anonymous: Signing out must work even when the session has already expired; it only ever revokes the caller's own session.

get.summary: The caller's session: user, workspace, permissions and menu, or authenticated = false with a fresh passkey sign-in challenge.
get.x-erp-anonymous: The sign-in screen asks whether a session exists; returns only the caller's own session.

get.summary: Users of the workspace, a page at a time: word search on name and e-mail, filters, sort, keyset or offset paging and grouping (the list query contract); newest first by default.

post.summary: Create a user with roles. Without a password the user is invited and the answer carries a one-time set-up code. Roles may only grant permissions the caller holds.

get.summary: One user.

put.summary: Change a user's name, language, active flag and roles. Only users whose access is within the caller's own; callers cannot change their own roles or deactivate themselves.

delete.summary: Delete a user who has never signed in (for example an invitation sent to a mistyped address). Anyone who has signed in keeps their record for the audit trail: deactivate them instead. Only a caller who holds every permission the user holds, never on themselves.

post.summary: Reset another user's password: a new one-time set-up code, or a given (temporary) password. Ends the user's sessions. Only users whose access is within the caller's own.
Clear every sign-in pause on another user's account (failed attempts before now stop counting).
Sign another user out everywhere: ends all of their sessions.

get.summary: What the user can do and why: their roles, and every permission they hold with the roles that grant it.
The company the user works in by default (until they switch in the top bar), and the companies of the caller's they may work in.

put.summary: Set the company another user works in by default (null: their first company by code). Only a company of the caller's the user may work in, only for users whose access is within the caller's own and who work in no company the caller does not; never on oneself (switch in the top bar instead).

get.summary: The companies the caller works in: where the caller may assign roles that apply in one company, and name a default company.
The user's sign-in history, newest first (successes, failures, paused and refused attempts), and the clients paused now.

post.summary: Activate or deactivate every user the users list's search and filter match (the list's "all that match" selection). expectedCount must equal the number that match now, or nothing changes (409). The caller is never deactivated, and users holding a permission the caller lacks (workspace-wide or in one company) or any role in a company the caller does not work in are left alone; the answer counts each.

get.summary: Roles of the workspace with the permissions they grant and their user counts, under the list query contract (search, filters, sort, paging, grouping); system roles first by default.

post.summary: Create a role. It may only grant permissions the caller holds.

get.summary: One role.

put.summary: Rename a role or change its permissions. Only a caller who holds every permission the role grants, before and after the change; system roles cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Delete a role and its assignments. Only a caller who holds every permission the role grants, and not a role the caller holds; system roles cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Create a new role with the same permissions as this one, under a new name. Only roles whose permissions the caller holds.

get.summary: Every permission in the catalogue with its label in the caller's language.

put.summary: Change the signed-in user's own preferences (interface language, digits on Arabic screens).

get.summary: The signed-in user's passkeys, and until when this session may add one (a passkey is added only within a few minutes of signing in).

post.summary: Add a passkey: the browser's answer to the creation options. The answer must be for this site, made by a verified person, with an ES256 or RS256 key, and answer a challenge issued to this session.

Options for navigator.credentials.create(): a fresh challenge bound to this session, the user handle and the passkeys the device must not make again. 403 auth.recentSignInRequired when the session was signed in too long ago.

get.summary: One of the signed-in user's passkeys (name, dates and version, never its key).

put.summary: Rename one of the signed-in user's passkeys.

delete.summary: Remove one of the signed-in user's passkeys: it no longer signs in (the device may still list it until the person deletes it there).

get.summary: Another user's passkeys (names and dates, never keys).

delete.summary: Remove every passkey of another user (a lost device, a person leaving): only for users whose access is within the caller's own, never on oneself.

get.summary: The reports the caller may run (each needs the read permission of the data it prints) and the lists the caller may print, with titles, parameters and columns in the caller's language.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language of the titles and labels; the request's language by default.

get.summary: Run the tenancy.companyProfile report: as a JSON document (format=json), a PDF in English or Arabic (format=pdf), or its rows as CSV or XLSX.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Reference parameter (required).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (the document), pdf, csv or xlsx; json by default.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The document's language, which may differ from the screen's; the request's language by default.

parameters.name: numerals
parameters.description: Digits of an Arabic document: latn (0-9) or arab (٠-٩); latn by default.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: IANA time zone the document shows times in; the workspace's by default.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: A column to group the rows by (with counts and totals).

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: attachment (download, the default) or inline (open in the browser), for a PDF.

200.description: The document as JSON (format=json, the default), or the file asked for: a PDF (format=pdf), the rows as CSV (format=csv) or as an XLSX workbook (format=xlsx).

get.summary: Run the tenancy.branchDirectory report: as a JSON document (format=json), a PDF in English or Arabic (format=pdf), or its rows as CSV or XLSX.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Reference parameter.

parameters.name: emirate
parameters.description: Choice parameter.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Boolean parameter.

parameters.name: format

ListColumnType.description:
Kind of value a list column shows; the list framework picks the cell format,
    filter editor, operators and alignment from it.

key.description: The value (null for rows without one).

totals.description: Sum of each total-carrying number column over the group (decimal strings).

moneyTotals.description:
Sum of each total-carrying money column over the group, one line per
    currency (amounts in different currencies are never added together; CLAUDE.md rule 2).

ListGroup.description: A group of rows sharing one value of the grouped column.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the amounts (null for rows without one).

ListMoneyTotal.description: The total of a money column over a group's rows in one currency.

total.description: Rows matching the search and filter (all pages).

next.description: Pass as `after` to read the following page; null on the last page.

groups.description: With `groupBy`: every group of the matching rows, ordered by key.

ranked.description:
The rows are in relevance order, best match first (a search without a
    sort, matching at most int ListSearch.MaxRankedRows rows).
